chunks: And from him, from Ayub ibn Nuha, from Safwan, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'Indeed, the night prayer is more effective in contact [with the divine] and more suitable for speech.' He said: 'Its standing up from the bed, intending only Allah, Exalted and Mighty.'

key_terms.أَشَدُّ وَطْئاً: More effective in contact / deeper in presence
key_terms.أَقْوَمُ قِيلاً: More upright in speech / more coherent in recitation

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'ashadd wat'an' in the night prayer verse according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the phrase 'ashadd wat'an' is interpreted not merely as physical exertion but as the spiritual clarity and sincerity achieved by rising from bed with exclusive devotion to Allah. This exegesis underscores the Shia emphasis on *ikhlas* (sincerity) as the primary determinant of a prayer's efficacy, distinguishing the quiet, focused nature of night worship from daytime recitations. It aligns with the broader theological view that the stillness of the night facilitates deeper contemplation (*tadabbur*) and connection with the Divine.
